name: The Algorithm Void
svgFragment:
<g id="BG-YOUTUBE-DASHBOARD">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1e1b4b" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0f172a" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="floorGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0f172a" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#020617" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="arrowGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ef4444" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b91c1c" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="goldGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fde047" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#eab308" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- BACKGROUND VOID (y: 0 to 540) -->
  <rect width="1280" height="540" fill="url(#bgGrad)" />

  <!-- THUMBNAIL SUNBURST RAYS -->
  <g opacity="0.08" fill="#facc15">
    <polygon points="640,270 -100,-100 200,-100" />
    <polygon points="640,270 400,-100 700,-100" />
    <polygon points="640,270 900,-100 1200,-100" />
    <polygon points="640,270 1380,0 1380,200" />
    <polygon points="640,270 1380,400 1200,540" />
    <polygon points="640,270 900,540 600,540" />
    <polygon points="640,270 300,540 0,540" />
    <polygon points="640,270 -100,400 -100,100" />
  </g>

  <!-- FLOATING GRAPH/ALGORITHM LINES -->
  <path d="M -50,300 Q 200,150 450,350 T 950,100 T 1330,250" fill="none" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.15" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <path d="M -50,320 Q 200,170 450,370 T 950,120 T 1330,270" fill="none" stroke="#ec4899" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.15" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- GIANT EXPOSED TEXT WITH THUMBNAIL STYLE LAYERED STROKES -->
  <g transform="translate(0, -10)">
    <!-- Shadow/3D Effect -->
    <text x="646" y="256" fill="#020617" font-family="'Impact', 'Arial Black', sans-serif" font-size="150" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-4, 640, 250)">EXPOSED!</text>
    <!-- Red Outer Glow/Border -->
    <text x="640" y="250" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="24" stroke-linejoin="round" font-family="'Impact', 'Arial Black', sans-serif" font-size="150" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-4, 640, 250)">EXPOSED!</text>
    <!-- White Inner Border -->
    <text x="640" y="250" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="12" stroke-linejoin="round" font-family="'Impact', 'Arial Black', sans-serif" font-size="150" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-4, 640, 250)">EXPOSED!</text>
    <!-- Main Yellow Text -->
    <text x="640" y="250" fill="url(#goldGrad)" font-family="'Impact', 'Arial Black', sans-serif" font-size="150" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-4, 640, 250)">EXPOSED!</text>
  </g>

  <!-- FLOATING RED ARROWS (Pointing to center stage) -->
  <!-- Left Arrow -->
  <path d="M 120,120 L 220,140 L 200,170 L 290,240 L 260,270 L 350,300 L 320,210 L 290,230 L 220,160 L 240,130 Z" fill="url(#arrowGrad)" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <!-- Right Arrow -->
  <path d="M 1160,120 L 1060,140 L 1080,170 L 990,240 L 1020,270 L 930,300 L 960,210 L 930,230 L 1000,160 L 980,130 Z" fill="url(#arrowGrad)" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <!-- FLOATING YELLOW CLICKBAIT CIRCLES -->
  <circle cx="280" cy="280" r="80" fill="none" stroke="#facc15" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="15, 10" />
  <circle cx="1000" cy="260" r="95" fill="none" stroke="#facc15" stroke-width="8" />
  <!-- Question Mark in Right Circle -->
  <text x="1000" y="300" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="5" font-family="'Arial Black', sans-serif" font-size="110" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">?</text>

  <!-- FLOATING CURSORS -->
  <path d="M 0,0 L 0,30 L 8,22 L 15,35 L 20,33 L 13,20 L 22,20 Z" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" transform="translate(380, 280) scale(1.5) rotate(-15)" />
  <path d="M 0,0 L 0,30 L 8,22 L 15,35 L 20,33 L 13,20 L 22,20 Z" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" transform="translate(880, 220) scale(1.5) rotate(25)" />

  <!-- GIANT DOWNWARD POINTING ARROW (Pointing to Character Spot) -->
  <path d="M 640,460 L 590,380 L 620,380 L 620,310 L 660,310 L 660,380 L 690,380 Z" fill="url(#goldGrad)" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <!-- BADGES / UI OVERLAYS -->
  <!-- Live Badge -->
  <g transform="translate(60, 50)">
    <rect width="110" height="45" rx="8" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="5" />
    <text x="55" y="31" fill="#ffffff" font-family="'Arial Black', sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">LIVE</text>
  </g>
  <!-- View Count Badge -->
  <g transform="translate(1000, 50)">
    <rect width="220" height="45" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="3" />
    <circle cx="25" cy="22" r="8" fill="#22c55e" />
    <text x="120" y="28" fill="#ffffff" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">9,999,999 VIEWS</text>
  </g>

  <!-- STAGE FLOOR (y: 540 to 720) -->
  <rect x="0" y="540" width="1280" height="180" fill="url(#floorGrad)" />

  <!-- HORIZON BORDER LINE -->
  <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="5" />
  <!-- Horizon Glow -->
  <rect x="0" y="543" width="1280" height="6" fill="#ef4444" opacity="0.6" />
  <rect x="0" y="549" width="1280" height="12" fill="#facc15" opacity="0.2" />

  <!-- PERSPECTIVE GRID LINES ON FLOOR -->
  <g stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="640" y1="540" x2="-200" y2="720" />
    <line x1="640" y1="540" x2="150" y2="720" />
    <line x1="640" y1="540" x2="480" y2="720" />
    <line x1="640" y1="540" x2="800" y2="720" />
    <line x1="640" y1="540" x2="1130" y2="720" />
    <line x1="640" y1="540" x2="1480" y2="720" />
  </g>

  <!-- HORIZONTAL GRID LINES -->
  <line x1="0" y1="565" x2="1280" y2="565" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5" />
  <line x1="0" y1="600" x2="1280" y2="600" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.5" opacity="0.6" />
  <line x1="0" y1="650" x2="1280" y2="650" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.8" />
  <line x1="0" y1="710" x2="1280" y2="710" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4" />

  <!-- FLOOR SHADOWS / CLICKBAIT TARGETS -->
  <!-- Giant Red Dashed Circle on Floor (Character Stand Spot) -->
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="630" rx="180" ry="45" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="20, 12" />
  <!-- Ambient Shadow under Character Spot -->
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="630" rx="140" ry="30" fill="#000000" opacity="0.4" />

  <!-- Ambient Shadows under Floating Elements -->
  <ellipse cx="280" cy="590" rx="70" ry="15" fill="#000000" opacity="0.5" />
  <ellipse cx="1000" cy="600" rx="80" ry="18" fill="#000000" opacity="0.5" />

  <!-- 100% REAL BANNER ON FLOOR -->
  <g transform="translate(640, 685) rotate(-2)">
    <polygon points="-150,-25 150,-25 140,25 -140,25" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <text x="0" y="8" fill="#ffffff" font-family="'Arial Black', sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NOT CLICKBAIT!</text>
  </g>
</g>
